parsed.text: Two panels (p0, p1) provide 4×4 discrete location distributions for red and blue at four nodes (n0–n3). Current distributions (view=current) are inherited/copied records and are not new estimates: for both panels n0 shows concentrated mass on the upper-left 2×2 block for red (peak cells [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]) and on the upper-right 2×2 block for blue (peak cells [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]); nodes n1–n3 are uniform 4×4 for both roles. Conditional command records (candidate view) are hypothetical branches, not executed events. Across candidate commands: k1 yields uniform distributions at all nodes; k0 matches the current concentration at n0 and uniform elsewhere; k2 places very sharp single-cell peaks at n0 (blue peak [0,2], red peak [0,0]) with other nodes uniform. The packet reports only these distributional estimates and their peak cell sets.
